FIELDS.NAME: Quality Doors & Windows Inc.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
Quality Doors & Windows Inc. specializes in the installation and sales of high-quality residential and commercial doors and windows. Our operations focus on providing excellent customer service, ensuring each installation meets local building codes and safety regulations. Our team of skilled installers is trained in industry best practices, and we maintain a strong emphasis on quality control throughout the installation process. We work exclusively with licensed and insured subcontractors to ensure compliance and manage liability effectively. Our comprehensive approach includes documenting safety procedures and conducting regular safety audits to minimize workplace accidents. With a commitment to customer satisfaction, we perform post-installation inspections and follow-ups, fostering strong client relationships and reducing the potential for claims. Our business is dedicated to upholding high standards and maintaining a clean operational record, free from legal issues or insurance claims, to ensure a reliable and trustworthy service for all our clients.

Compliance Confirmation: The business does not engage in any activities related to risks with a history of frequent or severe claims related to installation defects and confirms that all subcontractors are fully insured and verified. Additionally, we do not undertake high-rise, industrial, or hazardous installation projects, and we maintain comprehensive documented employee safety training and installation procedures to ensure compliance and safety standards.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: Loss Dates: 03/15/2023; Cause: Damage due to improper installation of a residential window leading to water intrusion; Amount: $1,200; Status: Closed with full payment from contractor liability coverage.
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Friday: 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM; Saturday: 9:00 AM - 2:00 PM; Sunday: Closed
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Fencing and on-site security watchpersons for enhanced protection during installations.
